goal: Disconnect peers that send transaction announcements when transaction relay is disabled
Ignore invalid witness transaction announcements on wtxid-relay connections to adhere to BIP 144
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified through mutation testing on functional test scripts (fametrano)
Code approvals with minor nonblocking suggestions for tests (fjahr, instagibbs)
Early compatibility objections regarding Neutrino peers in the wild were addressed (darosior, 0xB10C)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge case where peers announcing txs avoided disconnects on relay-disabled links
Brings announcement handling in line with BIP 144 without breaking compatibility for older nodes
